en: Illustrated vintage postcard showing the Mosque of Muhammad Ali inside the Citadel of Cairo. The scene depicts the large domed mosque with tall minarets rising above massive fortress walls. In the foreground are people in traditional clothing, one riding a camel along a path, others standing or sitting near stone walls, with a stylized cityscape in the distance. The sky is rendered in warm sunset tones. The front contains printed French text naming the city and mosque, along with handwritten script at the bottom.
